summary: 3 film announcements, 5 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: X-Men
film.announcement: Samara Weaving lands the role of Emma Frost in the upcoming Marvel Studios X-Men film directed by Jake Schreier.

film.title: Learning to Fly
film.announcement: Chris Hemsworth's Wild State production company boards the ultra marathon-themed documentary from award-winning director Max Lowe.

film.title: Lockjaw
film.announcement: Bob Yari's Magenta Light Studios acquires the dark comedy film Lockjaw.

tv.title: Better Than The Movies
tv.announcement: Beatrice Kitsos and David Iacono land the lead roles in Netflix's YA rom-com adaptation of Better Than The Movies.

tv.title: The Secret of Secrets
tv.announcement: Rebecca Hall officially joins the Netflix series based on Dan Brown's novel The Secret of Secrets.

tv.title: Trial of Louise Woodward
tv.talent: Meghann Fahy (lead), Matthew Barry (creator), Susanne Bier (director)
tv.announcement: Meghann Fahy is set to lead the HBO limited series Trial of Louise Woodward from creator Matthew Barry and director Susanne Bier.

tv.title: Crystal Lake
tv.announcement: HBO Max picks up the Friday the 13th prequel series Crystal Lake for distribution across Europe.

tv.title: The Leftovers
tv.announcement: SallyAnn Salsano returns to New Jersey with the reality series The Leftovers for Netflix.
